HEEWON STYLE — a premium KOREAN WEBTOON / MANHWA splash illustration of a relationship, lit with cinematic tenebrism. A 2:1 movie frame composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop (nothing important at the top or bottom edge). MEDIUM CLOSE TWO-SHOT, waist-up, both faces large. DRAW IT EXACTLY IN THE STYLE OF THE ATTACHED CHARACTER SHEET: the same clean confident black ink linework, the same manhwa face design (eye shape, brows, nose, jaw, hairline and hair). It must read as an INKED DRAWING: visible line strokes everywhere — bold tapered contour lines around every figure, drawn fold lines in the silk and armour, hair drawn as inked strands, a little cross-hatching and line shading in the shadows — then flat cel-shading in two or three tones per colour, no airbrushed gradients. Each face must be recognisably the character drawn on the sheet, wearing the same clothes. NOT realistic, NOT an oil painting, NOT photoreal, NOT painterly, NOT a 3D render, no skin pores or photographic texture. ONLY THESE TWO PEOPLE in the frame. THE STRICT UNCLE AND HIS APPRENTICE NEPHEW. Bupmin, a beardless teenage hwarang exactly as on the sheet (red headband, no crown, not yet king), is at full draw with a Korean horn bow, arm trembling, teeth gritted, sweat on his brow. Yushin stands right behind him, pushing the boy's bow elbow up with two fingers, the other hand firm on his shoulder, stern, eyes on the unseen target. Blue light on Yushin, crimson on Bupmin. His sword stays sheathed at his hip. Any sword is the ancient straight Korean ring-pommel dao: a small iron ring pommel, a short wrapped grip, a thin metal band and NO hand guard, a perfectly straight blade — never a katana, never a tsuba. CHARACTER SHEET (copy these faces, hair and clothes exactly): LEFT of the sheet = KIM YUSHIN; RIGHT of the sheet = BUPMIN. KIM YUSHIN — Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows, deep-set eyes. Dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry. Now: Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband. Colour #2A5FB8. | BUPMIN — Look: Square jaw, goatee and moustache, confident grin; arms folded when he is pleased with himself. Dress: As king: crimson robe with gold dragon embroidery, blue shoulder pieces, gold Silla crown. Earlier: prince/hwarang stage portraits. Colour #C41E3A. LIGHT AND BACKGROUND (dark manhwa tenebrism, like a dramatic manhwa splash page): a MINIMAL MONOTONE background — one flat dark field in a single hue (the characters' colour deepened almost to black), at most a few soft wisps of smoke in that same hue; no set, no architecture, no landscape, no furniture, no props beyond what the characters hold or sit on; ONE hard directional light from the side or below carves the faces and silk in high contrast, the far side of each figure falling off into black shadow, a thin edge of the same light along the silhouettes; deep inky blacks, crisp highlights, strong cast shadows across the faces. Each person's colour is the colour of the light and the shadow-tint on them — never a glow aura or halo. BLOCKING, BODY LANGUAGE AND FACIAL EXPRESSIONS show the relationship at a glance. Faces and clothes from the sheet; new poses, never the sheet's stance. One of each person, never cloned. No text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no panel borders, no watermark.
